blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Former Vice President and incumbent Naga City Mayor Maria Leonor “Leni” Robredo has nominated and endorsed Supreme Court Senior Associate Justice Marvic M.V.F. Leonen as the next chief justice. Robredo’s nomination and endorsement are contained in a letter dated Sept. 11, 2026, addressed to President Ferdinand Marcos Jr., with a copy furnished to the Judicial and Bar Council (JBC) and its chair, Chief Justice Alexander Gesmundo. The Judicial and Bar Council (JBC) and the Office of Chief Justice Alexander Gesmundo officially received the endorsement on Sept. 23, 2026.
